subject.title: fix: preserve zero sequence ids in sdk events

question: Should OpenClaw accept the corrected zero-preserving normalized ID as an intentional SDK-visible compatibility change for edge events?
rationale: The implementation is technically correct, but maintainers must decide whether correcting the ID identity contract outweighs possible cross-version dedupe changes for consumers that persist normalized IDs.

options.title: Accept corrected identity

options.body: Pause merge until persisted-ID support is defined and the PR adds the corresponding migration, versioning, or cross-version compatibility behavior.
